article.title: Ambassador Formosa bestows a high honor on two prominent figures in Ukrainian music
article.summary:
(ANSA) - ROMA, 31 AGO - The Italian Ambassador to Ukraine, Carlo Formosa, conferred the Order of the Star of Italy on two leading figures in Ukrainian musical culture: the renowned opera director Anatoliy Solovianenko and the rector of the National Academy of Music, the Kyiv Conservatory, Maksym Tymoshenko. In an official ceremony, Ambassador Formosa presented the honors to Solovianenko and Tymoshenko—as Officer and Knight, respectively—on behalf of the President of the Italian Republic.
As Ambassador Formosa emphasized in his speech, the conferral of these honors on Anatoliy Solovianenko and Maksym Tymoshenko represents a high recognition of their personal contributions to the development of Ukrainian culture, the musical arts, and education, as well as to the strengthening of cultural ties between Ukraine and Italy.
